@@U03362@@
Their pride overweening! Kill them, slay them, All together, So each of our helmets Can boast its own feather!

@@U03364@@
Iron we bring them— Ah, who is to save us!— Which into harsh chains They forge to enslave us. The time’s not yet come To rise in defiance; So bow to your tyrants In lowly compliance.

@@U03366@@
Shrieks of murder, dying groans, Wings that flutter in dismay, Ah, what outcry and what moans To us in flight here pierce their way! They are all already dead, The placid lake with blood is red. Reckless passion for display Raped the heron’s plumes away. Behold their helmets! See it wave On each bowlegged paunchy knave! You companions of our host, Wedge-shaped wanderers of our coast, Hear our cry, on you we call For vengeance that affects us all. Death, so we avenge their fate! To this rabble deathless hate!

@@U03367@@
(They scatter, screeching, in the air.)

@@U03369@@
(On the plain.)

@@U03370@@
I’ve always known how to master Nordic witches; it’s these foreign types I just can't get the knack of.
translation:
@@U03362@@
他们的骄傲自大！杀了他们，杀了他们，一起，所以我们的每个头盔都可以夸耀自己的羽毛！

@@U03364@@
我们给他们带来了铁——啊，谁来拯救我们！——他们将铁链锻造成严酷的锁链来奴役我们。反抗的时刻尚未到来；所以，你要低声下气地向你的暴君低头。

@@U03366@@
谋杀的尖叫声，垂死的呻吟， 沮丧地扑动的翅膀， 啊，对我们在这里飞行的我们来说，有什么叫喊和呻吟刺穿了他们的道路！他们都已经死了，平静的湖水被血染红了。鲁莽的展示热情夺去了苍鹭的羽毛。看看他们的头盔！看它在每个罗圈腿、大腹便便的无赖身上挥舞！你们是我们东道主的同伴，我们海岸上的楔形流浪者，请聆听我们的呼声，我们向你们呼唤，为影响我们所有人的复仇。死亡，让我们为命运报仇！对这乌合之众有不死之恨！

@@U03367@@
（它们尖叫着在空中四散开来。）

@@U03369@@
（在平原上。）

@@U03370@@
我一直知道如何征服北欧女巫；这些是我无法掌握的外国类型。
